title: NinjaScript 8 code for referencing multiple indicators as inputs by yellowd
text:
Programación en C# NinjaScript 8 code for referencing multiple indicators as inputs 
A simple and generic sample code to call and manipulate multiple input data streams in the form of NinjaTrader 8 indicators. Example I have a chart with multiple data streams - stocks, and for each stock there is a standard RSI indicator plotted, there are 3 of them. Now the task is to create another custom indicator in NinjaScript to add all of them and display output, e.g. RSI(AAPL)+RSI(EBAY)+RSI(AMZN) -> output. The design should be generic hence any other indicator can be referenced in the future.
